title: Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, 16-Inch | Brushed Bronze | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more storage at the vanity without sacrificing counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf keeps daily bathroom essentials organized and adds an integrated towel bar for convenient towel storage in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

  • Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Pairs with matching Waverly Place accessories for a warm, cohesive aesthetic
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose enduring hardware crafted from solid brass.
  • Create a coordinated look with transitional bath accessories from the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place pieces.

Specs & Installation

  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Overall projection: 5 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 Inch (3/8 Inch)
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Designed to pair with versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware, this shelf complements the sophisticated, adaptable look of the Waverly Place Collection.
